tray.tooltip.running.note: Tray tooltip while a run is active. Windows limits the tooltip to 127 characters.

tray.tooltip.today.note: Tray tooltip for today's progress. earned is formatted points earned today. total is earned plus still-open points and selects the plural. Keep below 127 characters where possible.

tray.tooltip.idle.note: Tray tooltip when today's points could not be read. Keep below 127 characters.

tray.menu.open.note: First tray menu item and default left-click action. Shows and focuses the window.

tray.menu.run_now.note: Tray menu action when no run is active. Starts the configured active accounts.

tray.menu.stop.note: Tray menu action while a run is active. Requests a graceful stop.

tray.menu.next_check.note: Disabled tray menu line in automatic mode. time is the next scheduled local time, already formatted for Windows regional settings.

tray.menu.next_run.note: Disabled tray menu line in fixed mode. time is the next scheduled local time, already formatted for Windows regional settings.

tray.menu.manual.note: Disabled tray menu line when no check or run is scheduled.

tray.menu.quit.note: Last tray menu item. Stops the window app and tray but never stops an active farmer run.

tray.notify.done.title.note: Windows notification title after a run that completed without a problem.

tray.notify.done.body.note: Completion notification body. points is points gained in this run and selects the plural. balance is the total known current account balance, already formatted.

tray.notify.done.body_no_balance.note: Completion notification body when the balance is unknown but points gained are known. points selects the plural.

tray.notify.done.body_no_points.text: The run finished. Open Rewards Farmer to see the details.
tray.notify.done.body_no_points.note: Completion notification body when points gained could not be measured. Never replace an unknown count with zero.

tray.notify.problem.title.note: Windows notification title for a run problem or an account that needs sign-in. Body comes from the matching error key.

tray.notify.signed_out.text: {account} needs you to sign in again.
tray.notify.signed_out.note: Windows notification body for a signed-out account. account is its user-chosen label or localized default label.

tray.notify.closed_to_tray.text: Rewards Farmer is still in the tray. Choose Quit there to close it.
tray.notify.closed_to_tray.note: Shown once after the first window close that hides to the tray. Closing the app does not stop runs.
